about_the_game:
◆ Welcome to Dockside Dreams!

In this relaxing life simulation set in a peaceful seaside town, build your own dockside restaurant and make your dreams come true. Sail into the sea with your boat and catch various seafood by fishing or diving. Create special dishes from fish sandwiches to octopus meals and satisfy your customers.

◆ Fish, Dive, Explore

Use different fishing rods to catch various fish in different areas of the open sea. Buy new boats to travel farther. Dive into unexplored underwater worlds to hunt unique sea creatures.

◆ Prepare Perfect Dishes

Use precise cleaning and seasoning methods for each fish to create flawless dishes. Garnish your meals with appetizers and salads.

◆ Customize Your Restaurant

Use your earnings to decorate your restaurant and acquire new equipment as you like.

◆ Interact with the Locals!

Trade with and befriend the people living in this seaside town.

◆ Discover the World!

Adventures await in every corner of this world nestled between wild forests and undiscovered underwater realms.

Dockside Dreams is ideal for anyone looking to relax or build their own small restaurant by the sea, combining seafood hunting, cooking, and management mechanics.

name: Dockside Dreams – Fish & Cook Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti veya Intel UHD 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 veya 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F veya AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 veya üzeri
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Dockside Dreams – Multiplayer Fish & Cook Simulator. Catch seafood by fishing or diving, cook and serve it in your restaurant. Customize your place, explore the sea, and build the best dockside restaurant with friends in CO-OP mode.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Turkish
